templates.name: Flea Treatment Prep (No Email)
templates.body:
Hello {first_name}! Before your flea visit:

- Vacuum carpets, rugs, and pet resting areas, emptying outside.
- Wash pet bedding on a hot cycle.
- Coordinate pet flea control with your vet, and keep people and pets off treated areas until dry.
templates.description: Self-contained flea prep text sent when a first-time flea treatment is booked for a customer with no email on file.

templates.name: Bed Bug Treatment Prep (No Email)
templates.body:
Hello {first_name}! Before your bed bug visit:

- Launder bedding and affected clothing in hot water, dry on high 30+ min, then bag it.
- Vacuum mattresses, frames, and baseboards, emptying outside.
- Pull beds and furniture 12-18 in. from walls.

Repeat all three before your 14-day follow-up.
templates.description: Self-contained bed bug prep text sent when a first-time bed bug treatment is booked for a customer with no email on file.

templates.name: Cockroach Control Prep (No Email)
templates.body:
Hello {first_name}! Before your cockroach visit:

- Clear access under sinks, around appliances, and along pantry edges.
- Store food, dishes, and pet bowls away from treatment areas.
- Skip store-bought sprays, which scatter the activity.
templates.description: Self-contained cockroach prep text sent when a first-time cockroach treatment is booked for a customer with no email on file.
